description: Geometric fingerprint of one STEP part, independent of position and orientation (volume, area, principal sizes, face types). Use it to recognise the same part under different file names or to sort many files before comparing pairs; two parts with clearly different fingerprints are different, similar fingerprints still need compare.

path.description: Absolute path to a part file (.step or .stp) on this computer. For a file the user attached to the chat, pass the path you have; if it is not on this computer, the file with the same name in the user's folders is used

name: fingerprint

bbox_sorted.description: Size along the principal axes, largest first, mm

face_types.description: Face count by surface type (plane, cylinder, cone, sphere, torus, bspline, …)

integration_exact.description: false: freeform surfaces, volume and moments are close estimates

principal_moments.description: Principal moments of inertia, smallest first (density 1)
